remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Not recorded Abiquiú Notebooks. Whitney Archive indicates, "Note: Miss O'Keeffe thinks this is the 'Leaves' sold to Cora L. Hartshorn." Pictured in 1924 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 24. Reproduced and titled *Green Leaves* in *The Arts* (April 1924). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Green Oak Leaves (58.168) was deaccessioned from the The Newark Museum of Art in 2021 and sold at Sotheby's New York: Wednesday, May 19, 2021 [Lot 00007], American Art. (Source: The Newark Museum of Art, 2025)

titles.title: Leaves

description: A cluster of several overlapping, vibrant green oak leaves spring from a central point. The frontmost leaves are a bright, yellowish green, while the ones in the back are a darker shade. The background is painted in shades of gray.
title: Leaves
